name: Tsukasa Tsukasa
source:
His last and first name are identical.
Even though he is in the same class as Yuuta, people often believe he is several years younger.
His pants fall down at the gentlest touch.
There seems to be a mysterious creature watching him. He said himself it was a "small demon".

[From in-game charater profile]

A member of class 503.
